id: 02_Lesson 6 How to Cut Long Materials Using Passthrough？
title: 第6课：如何用贯通口切割长料
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/02_Lesson 6 How to Cut Long Materials Using Passthrough？.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/02_Lesson 6 How to Cut Long Materials Using Passthrough？/src.py

points.K1: 这一课：切比幅面还长的板
points.K13: 箭头对准十字，记下坐标

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台封闭式激光切割机旁，机器两侧各有一条窄槽
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large enclosed laser cutting machine with a narrow slot on each side and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：怎么切比机器还长的板。
overlay: 超长板材的分段激光切割

shots.scene: 一块长金属板穿过机器，两侧都露在外面的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a long metal sheet passing straight through an enclosed cutting machine, sticking out of both side slots. No people.
shots.narration: 秘诀就是两侧的穿透槽。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一张很长的门牌设计图，皱眉看着机器的工作台
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a long blank sign drawing and frowns at the cutting bed of the enclosed machine.
shots.narration: 小研要做一块长门牌，比工作台还长。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿尺子比画，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student measures the cutting bed with a tape and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：放不下，只能锯短了。

shots.scene: 老李笑着指向机器侧面的窄槽
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer smiles and points to the narrow slot on the side of the machine.
shots.narration: 老李说：分两段切，照样能接上。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 关键在于两段对得准。

shots.section_title: 这一课：切比幅面还长的板
shots.scene: 一块薄不锈钢长板平放在台面上，旁边虚线框表示幅面
shots.prompt_en: A long thin stainless steel sheet lies on a table; a dashed rectangle beside it shows the much shorter cutting area. No people.
shots.narration: 以1毫米厚的不锈钢板为例。
overlay: 这一课：切比幅面还长的板

shots.section_title: 这一课：切比幅面还长的板
shots.scene: 长板被分成左右两段的示意，中间一条接缝
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the long sheet divided into a left part and a right part with a joint line in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 切完一段，挪一挪，再切另一段。

shots.scene: 小研戴着白色棉纱手套，把长板从左侧槽推进机器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing white cotton work gloves pushes the long metal sheet into the machine through the narrow left side slot.
shots.narration: 切割前，把板材从侧槽穿进去。

shots.scene: 左右两个侧槽都亮起的示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the machine seen from the front with both side slots highlighted in green. No people.
shots.narration: 左右两边都能进，这次从左往右。

shots.scene: 板材两端到机架的距离用两个红色箭头标出，长度相同
shots.prompt_en: Top view diagram of the sheet inside the machine with two red arrows at both ends showing equal distance to the machine frame. No people.
shots.narration: 固定前，两端到机架的距离要相等。

shots.scene: 板材歪斜的示意图打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the sheet lying slightly crooked in the machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不相等，板材就会斜过去。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手拧紧两侧夹具旋钮
shots.prompt_en: Close view of gloved hands tightening the fixture knobs on both sides of the cutting bed.
shots.narration: 对齐后，拧紧两侧的夹具旋钮。

shots.scene: 老李把一个铜色切割嘴装到切割头上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws a copper cutting nozzle onto the cutting head inside the open machine.
shots.narration: 装上合适的切割嘴。

shots.scene: 空压机通过软管连到机器，压力表指针稳定
shots.prompt_en: An air compressor is connected to the machine with a hose; the needle on a blank gauge stays steady. No people.
shots.narration: 用空压机供气，气压600千帕。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕上一个空心字母O被切掉只剩圆洞的示意
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing a hollow letter O outline; next to it the cut result is just a round hole with the inner part fallen out. No people.
shots.narration: 字母O直接切，中间那块会掉下来。

shots.scene: 在O中间竖着加一个窄长方形
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, a narrow vertical rectangle is placed across the middle of the letter O. No people.
shots.narration: O中间竖着放一条5毫米宽的矩形。

shots.scene: 合并后O被连接筋分开，内芯保留
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, after subtracting, the letter O shows two small bridges holding the inner oval in place. No people.
shots.narration: 合并减去后，内芯就保住了。

shots.scene: 屏幕上两个小孔和外边框合并成一体
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, two small round holes and a long frame outline merge into one shape. No people.
shots.narration: 孔和边框，合并成一个整体。

shots.scene: 图层面板，字母图层被拖到边框图层上方
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, a simple layer panel where the letters layer is dragged above the frame layer, shown with an up arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 字母图层要放在边框图层上面。

shots.scene: 字母和边框合并后得到完整门牌图案
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the letters and the frame merge into one complete long sign design with blank letter shapes. No people.
shots.narration: 再合并，就得到最终的加工图。

shots.scene: 长图案超出画布，旋转90度的箭头
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, a long sign design sticks out of the canvas; a curved arrow shows it rotating ninety degrees. No people.
shots.narration: 图案太长，先旋转九十度。

shots.scene: 一条矩形分割线放在两个字母之间的空白处
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, a thin rectangle is placed as a split line in the blank space between two letters. No people.
shots.narration: 分割线尽量放在空白处。

shots.scene: 分割线切过一个字母中间，旁边尺寸箭头
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the split line passes through the middle of one letter; a long size arrow shows the right part would be too long. No people.
shots.narration: 空白处分，右段超600毫米，只好切字中间。

shots.scene: 屏幕上图案被复制成上下两份
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the whole design is copied and pasted, with one copy placed below the other. No people.
shots.narration: 复制一份图案，放在下面。

shots.scene: 矩形与图案相减，分出左半和右半
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, a rectangle subtracts from each copy, leaving a left half and a right half. No people.
shots.narration: 用矩形相减，分出左半和右半。

shots.scene: 剪刀图标点在一条多余线上，线变色
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, a scissors cursor clicks on an unwanted line that changes color. No people.
shots.narration: 多余的线，用剪刀工具删掉。

shots.scene: 左半黑色，右半红色
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the left half of the design is black and the right half is red. No people.
shots.narration: 两半换成不同颜色，好区分。

shots.scene: 软件参数面板：模式、材料、气体、喷嘴四栏
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, a blank settings panel with four rows marked by icons: a clamp, a metal sheet, a gas bottle and a nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 选夹具切割，材料1毫米304不锈钢。

shots.scene: 气体选空压机，喷嘴选切割嘴
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, an air compressor icon and a cutting nozzle icon are selected with green frames. No people.
shots.narration: 气体选空压机，喷嘴选2毫米切割嘴。

shots.scene: 红色图案的输出开关被关掉
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the output toggle of the red half is switched off. No people.
shots.narration: 第二段先关闭输出，不然会报错。

shots.scene: 黑色图案离板边留出一段距离，箭头标注
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the black half sits inside the sheet outline with a margin arrow between the design and the sheet edge. No people.
shots.narration: 图案边缘离板边留1.5厘米。

shots.scene: 切割头在板面上方，屏幕显示校准进度条
shots.prompt_en: The cutting head hovers over the metal sheet while a progress bar on the screen shows sensor calibration. No people.
shots.narration: 先点校准电容传感器，再点材料。

shots.scene: 切割头沿图案外框走一圈红光，老李按下设备按钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses a button on the machine while a red aiming dot traces the outer frame of the design on the sheet, lid closed.
shots.narration: 再走边框，看位置对不对。

shots.scene: 加工前检查页：喷嘴、气压、焦点三项打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist page on the screen with three items checked: a nozzle icon, a gauge icon and a focus icon. No people.
shots.narration: 点加工，读右侧的检查提示。

shots.scene: 切割头上的旋钮特写，指针指向一个刻度
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small knob on the cutting head with its pointer set to one tick mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确认切割头旋钮设在负1，点开始。

shots.scene: 机盖关闭，机内火花闪烁，小研站在操作台前
shots.prompt_en: The machine lid is closed and sparks flicker inside behind the tinted window; the female graduate student watches from the control desk wearing safety glasses.
shots.narration: 关好机盖，切出第一段。

shots.scene: 阿杰换上皮质耐热手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls on thick leather heat-resistant gloves.
shots.narration: 切完的板很烫，戴耐热手套再动。

shots.scene: 松开旋钮，板材平行向右推出一段
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands loosen the fixture knobs and push the sheet straight to the right through the slot.
shots.narration: 松开旋钮，板材平行往右移。

shots.scene: 两个红色箭头重新量两端距离
shots.prompt_en: Two red arrows again show equal distances from both ends of the sheet to the machine frame. No people.
shots.narration: 两端距离要和刚才一样。

shots.scene: 手拧紧旋钮
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a gloved hand tightening a fixture knob.
shots.narration: 确认后，再拧紧旋钮。

shots.scene: 红色光点落在第一段切线的末端
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small red aiming dot landing on the end point of the first cut line on the metal sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 把红光移到第一段切线的端点。

shots.scene: 红光较大，圆心对准接缝点
shots.prompt_en: A larger red dot is centered on the joint point, with a small crosshair showing its center. No people.
shots.narration: 光点大，就让圆心对准接缝点。

shots.scene: 屏幕上点向下箭头，切割头下降，红点变小
shots.prompt_en: On the screen a down arrow is clicked; the cutting head moves lower and the red dot becomes small and sharp. No people.
shots.narration: 让切割头下降，光点变小再微调。

shots.section_title: 箭头对准十字，记下坐标
shots.scene: 屏幕上黑色图案移走，红色图案打开输出
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the black half is moved off the canvas and the red half is switched on and placed on the canvas. No people.
shots.narration: 移走第一段，换第二段上场。
overlay: 箭头对准十字，记下坐标

shots.section_title: 箭头对准十字，记下坐标
shots.scene: 绿色箭头图案的尖端与十字准线重合
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the tip of a large green arrow shape overlaps exactly with a red crosshair. No people.
shots.narration: 加一个箭头，箭尖对准十字准线。

shots.section_title: 箭头对准十字，记下坐标
shots.scene: 小研在空白本子上记下两个数字格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in two blank boxes in a notebook next to the computer.
shots.narration: 记下这一点的横纵坐标。

shots.section_title: 箭头对准十字，记下坐标
shots.scene: 第二条切线端点重复操作，再记两格
shots.prompt_en: The red dot moves to the end of the second cut line, and two more blank boxes are filled in the notebook.
shots.narration: 第二条切线端点，再做一遍。

shots.scene: 图案一角对齐第一个箭头，另一角偏开
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, one corner of the red design matches the first arrow tip while the other corner is slightly off from the second arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 图案一角对齐，看另一角准不准。

shots.scene: 示意：板材斜了一个小角度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the sheet tilted by a tiny angle relative to the frame, with an angle arc. No people.
shots.narration: 对不上，说明板材挪的时候斜了。

shots.scene: 两点连线，计算器算出角度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of two points joined by a line and a blank calculator showing an angle result. No people.
shots.narration: 两点坐标代入斜率计算，得89.77度。

shots.scene: 九十度减去这个角度，得到很小的偏转量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a right angle minus the measured angle leaves a tiny slice of angle highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 九十度减去它，偏转量0.23度。

shots.scene: 图案按反方向转一点，两角都对上箭头
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the pattern rotates by a tiny angle until both of its corners touch the two arrow tips. No people.
shots.narration: 逆时针偏就输负0.23，两角对上。

shots.scene: 删掉箭头，红色图案输出打开
shots.prompt_en: On the screen, the arrow shapes are deleted and the output toggle of the red half is switched on. No people.
shots.narration: 删掉箭头，打开第二段的输出。

shots.scene: 红光沿第二段边框走一圈
shots.prompt_en: A red aiming dot traces the frame of the second half on the sheet, lid closed. No people.
shots.narration: 不用再校准传感器，但必须走边框。

shots.scene: 机盖关闭，第二段切割
shots.prompt_en: The lid is closed and the machine cuts the second half, sparks visible only behind the tinted window. No people.
shots.narration: 确认对准，切第二段。

shots.scene: 戴手套松开旋钮，从侧槽推出长板
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands loosen the knobs and slide the finished long sheet out through the side slot.
shots.narration: 松开旋钮，从侧槽推出板材。

shots.scene: 接缝处字母特写，看不出拼接痕迹
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a cut letter at the joint area of the sign; the cut edge looks smooth and continuous. No people.
shots.narration: 接缝几乎看不出来。

shots.scene: 小研举起长门牌，阿杰竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up the long finished metal sign with blank letter cutouts; the young male student gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 按步骤来，手动对位也很准。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现侧槽、等距箭头、旋钮图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons of a side slot, two equal arrows and a knob.
shots.narration: 侧槽穿板，两端等距，拧紧夹具。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现分割线、箭头和十字图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a split line, an arrow tip and a crosshair.
shots.narration: 分段设计，箭头对点，算准偏角。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现边框和剪刀图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a dashed frame and a pair of scissors.
shots.narration: 走边框检查，再切第二段。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、老李举着长门牌挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student, the young male student and the facility engineer hold the long metal sign together and wave goodbye.
shots.narration: 长板也能切得准，下次见！
